abstract: The Parties to the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) intend to hold the fourth meeting of the Environment Committee (Committee) on December 11, 2025. Following the government-to- government Committee meeting, the Committee will hold a virtual public session, pursuant to Article 24.26.8 of the USMCA. The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) invites interested parties to join the public session, and seeks written comments on the implementation and operation of Chapter 24 (Environment) prior to the public session.
action: Request for comments and notice of committee meetings.
